managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up yet
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need your bank account details and an ID card.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe needs your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments will not work until Stripe receives your business and bank account details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: You do not need to do anything. Stripe is reviewing what you sent and this page will update when the check is done.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and ready to take money.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments temporarily stopped
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Stripe has temporarily stopped card payments on your account until the problem is resolved.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: This account cannot use card payments
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot turn on card payments here. Please contact us and we will help you sort it out.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This website’s server is using the {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key but the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} key. Card payments would fail when a customer presses pay, so setting up Stripe is blocked until both keys match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set to the same environment and the website rebuilt afterwards — the public key (publishable key) is put in when the site is built, while the secret key (secret key) is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the Food Truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: Stripe must be connected by the owner of the bank account that receives the money, so it has to be set up from that person’s own logged-in account. Nothing is wrong with this Food Truck or HatchGrab.
managePayments.config.keyMissingTitle: Card payments not set up yet
managePayments.config.fetchTitle: We could not check this Food Truck’s Stripe account
managePayments.config.keyMissing: {name} has not been set — the embedded components cannot load.
managePayments.online.heading: Online payments
managePayments.online.body: Customers pay by card when they order. The money goes straight into your own Stripe account — we never hold it.
managePayments.online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} per payment for standard {region}. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s own fee for online orders depends on your plan — see Billing.
managePayments.online.testMode: Test mode. Real money cannot be taken yet.
managePayments.trialNote: This setup does not start your subscription and nothing is charged today. This is how customers pay you — your plan is separate.
managePayments.admin.title: Viewing as administrator
managePayments.admin.body: This Food Truck has not set up online payments yet. Only the owner can start it, from their own logged-in account — there is nothing to press here.
managePayments.toast.addDetails: Now please add your details for Stripe
managePayments.onboarding.restricted: From here Stripe carries on — you will log in to Stripe and update the details it needs.
managePayments.onboarding.firstRun: From here Stripe carries on — you will log in to Stripe and then enter your business and bank account details.
managePayments.details.title: Your Stripe details
managePayments.details.body: Change the bank account you receive money into, or update your business details and documents.
managePayments.walkUp.heading: Walk-up payments
managePayments.walkUp.body: How you take money at the truck. HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-up orders, whichever you choose.
managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square or a machine you already use. Nothing to set up — only your provider’s own fees.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as your online payments — a card reader, or tap-to-pay straight from your phone or tablet.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment for {region}, plus {surcharge} for tap payments through a phone or tablet. Other cards may cost more.
manageCharges.heading: Tax, tips and fees
manageCharges.rate.label: Sales tax rate
manageCharges.rate.hint: The rate you charge on every order. Customers see it added at checkout, on receipts and on tickets.
manageCharges.rate.regionDefault: Leave empty to charge {label} at {rate}%, which is the rate for prepared food in {region}.
manageCharges.included.label: {label} included in your prices
manageCharges.included.hint: Your prices already include {label}. This rate only says how much {label} is in each price, on receipts and tickets — nothing is added at checkout.
manageCharges.included.default: Leave empty to use {rate}%, which is the {label} rate for hot food sold as takeaway in {country}.
manageCharges.tips.label: Tips
manageCharges.tips.hint: Customers paying online by card can add a tip. All the tips are yours.
manageCharges.fee.label: Online service fee
manageCharges.fee.hint: Added to online orders only. Not added to “Pay at the truck” orders or walk-up orders. You receive it.
manageCharges.fee.example: Customers see it before paying, as one line: “{label} {amount}”.
manageCharges.fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a {fee} service fee to your customers’ online orders. You do not pay it and cannot change it.
takingPayment.heading: Taking payment
takingPayment.intro: How your team records the money for each order.
takingPayment.paidStepHelp: Adds a Confirm button when you add an order yourself, so you can send the order straight away and take the money later. Turn this on if you take phone orders or advance orders.
takingPayment.paidStepNote: This only affects orders you add yourself. It does not affect online orders.

manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: That message looks like spam, a booking request or something unrelated, so the WhatsApp auto-reply system will not answer.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: Replies are created by AI and may differ slightly each time, and may sometimes be wrong.

manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script could not load. The usual cause is an ad blocker or tracking protection.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Please try again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — press “Set up” to try again.

manageWhatsApp.card.title: WhatsApp auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customer questions automatically on your social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, please allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press “Set up” again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your Food Truck.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection needs renewing soon. Press “Reconnect” to keep WhatsApp auto-replies working.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies for Instagram direct messages. Will require an Instagram professional account.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies for Facebook Messenger. Will require a Facebook Page.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being sent
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so it must be fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: WhatsApp auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit
manageWhatsApp.limit.usage: Used {used, number} of {limit, number} · counting restarts {date}
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: At most {n} replies per customer within 24 hours, then one message saying you will reply yourself.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies stop when the limit is reached. We will email you at 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta bills your WhatsApp account for replies, not HatchGrab. From {from} the first {free, number} replies each month are free. Information correct as of {checked}; please check <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: Meta charges for WhatsApp replies, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Every reply HatchGrab sends for you is billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from} Meta gives {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are free. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s pricing</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is higher than Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Without a payment method Meta will stop all replies once the free replies are used up.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is higher than Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one Meta stops all replies once the free replies are used up.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: WhatsApp auto-replies stop immediately and HatchGrab can no longer access your WhatsApp account. Your number still works in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, please also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but could not complete the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — please contact us and we will finish it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked but no phone number came back. Press “Reconnect” and complete the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but we must register this number before replies can start. Please contact support — your setup is saved, do not do it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not register this number. Your setup is saved — please contact support instead of doing it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not turn on message sending. Your setup is saved — please contact support instead of doing it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. One number can answer for only one Food Truck. Please contact support and we will move it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost done — we could not finish saving. Your setup is saved, please contact support instead of doing it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. The WhatsApp auto-reply system will start answering messages sent to this number.

customDomain.address.noChange: Your website does not change — you just add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up yet.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address must allow us to set up the padlock — the little lock picture customers see beside the web address. Until they add us it will not appear, so we have stopped for now rather than leave you waiting. Please ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. Whoever looks after it must allow it first before this can work. Please ask them to change it, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something is already using that address. Please send the message on the next page to whoever looks after that address — they will know what to do.

customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like events.{domain} works best.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is looked after, then save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Only this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.hintExact: Copy this exactly, letter for letter.
customDomain.record.timing: It normally starts working within an hour, but it may take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Does someone else look after your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then go to “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud picture beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud picture stays orange the padlock will never appear, and nothing will say why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” from the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is, then select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one entry at once, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, then add a full stop (.) at the end.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop (.) at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the pop-up.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix but is not registered there, Wix cannot change this — whoever holds the address must change it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One DNS entry to add for {truckName}’s schedule page
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}’s current schedule on {address}, and one DNS entry needs adding to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting {truckName}’s current schedule on {address}, and one DNS entry needs adding to our domain, wherever our domain is held.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.wholeChan: That is the whole change — no other part of the website is affected, and the rest of our domain keeps working exactly as before. It normally starts working within an hour.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points to shows where we will trade next and always updates itself.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.replyTo: Reply to {email} if you have any questions.
customDomain.liveEmail.subject: {address} works now
customDomain.liveEmail.body: Your schedule now shows at your own address. Please go and look and check it is correct: open {address}, then make sure the events are yours and the dates are correct.
customDomain.liveEmail.confirm: Once you have checked, please open your settings on HatchGrab and tell us it is correct. Nothing depends on this step — it just lets us know a person has looked.
